For claims over £1,000, we need a second approver from Finance even if the first approver is at the right level. The Head of Finance can be the second approver for any claim over £1,000.
Managers can approve their own expenses up to £100 without needing another approver. Over £100, it goes to their line manager or the Head of Finance if they have no line manager.
Photos of receipts are acceptable for all claims, but they must show the date, amount, vendor, and items clearly. Blurry photos or cropped receipts need to be resubmitted.

The grant renewals changed the caps from April: the Youth Empowerment Programme grant now has a £60 daily subsistence limit per person. The Community Engagement Programme allows £95 per night for accommodation and no more than £35 daily for food.

We run payments twice a month: on the 10th for claims approved by the 25th of previous month, and on the 25th for claims approved by the 10th of current month. Miss those cutoffs and payment waits for next cycle.

When a line manager is away, their deputy approves claims. If no deputy, it goes to the department head. For Head of Finance absence, the Executive Director covers. All delegation must be set up in the system in advance.
